ValidationRule.description: This validation rule is used to validate application number
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Setup.Salesforce_Library_Settings__c.Disable_VRs__c = false, RecordType.DeveloperName = 'MLCRM_Opportunity', NOT($Profile.Name = "System Administrator"), NOT( OR( REGEX(Application_Numbers__c, '^(1|7|8)[0-9]{8}(,(1|7|8)[0-9]{8})*$'), ISBLANK(Application_Numbers__c) ) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please enter 9 numeric digits beginning with 1, 7 or 8 with no space. If there are multiple Application Numbers, they must be separated by a comma (,) e.g. "123456789,723456789"
